native.scope: Authenticated native OPA; loopback HTTP/MCP; counted synthetic SQLite/repository fixture adapters. No external GitHub or PostgreSQL calls.

isolation.reason: Run verify:isolation separately; native tests do not prove container isolation.

limitations: Synthetic local targets only. No host-admin or kernel-escape guarantee. Stage 2 target/control PostgreSQL and Git mock; no real GitHub or host-agent interception.

fixtureAccess.scope: Private host directory; owner and explicitly added runtime group only; agent mounts remain read-only

stage2.scope: Local MCP/REST gateway, separate PostgreSQL control/target and actual local Git with mock PR. No GitHub App or actual Codex client.

expandedBenchmark.scope: 208 prelabelled synthetic tasks; 8 parameter strata of 26 scenarios, including repeated reads and all 16 credential-shaped placeholders; actual direct adapter baseline versus gateway, sequential on one fixture with distinct branch names and per-step state checks; approvals by automated trusted fixture operator; task latency includes HTTP/target/snapshots, not provisioning or human wait; no general population or model-quality rate. Measurement PASS is not achievement of the separate <2% usability target.

credentialScan.scope: Exact known fixture credentials; operator separately scans issued credentials. Not a universal DLP scan.

security.limits: Semgrep OSS with eight local rules, npm advisories and dependency SBOM. Not exhaustive interprocedural analysis, OS image CVE coverage, penetration testing or external human review.

harnessCorrection.cause: The VM harness invoked node scripts/verify-security.mjs directly; the security contract requires npm run verify:security so npm_execpath is explicit for SBOM and audit.
harnessCorrection.observedBeforeCorrection: Semgrep completed with 0 findings on 123 files, then the npm CLI precondition failed.
harnessCorrection.correction: Only the local validation harness invocation changed. Product source, archive, policy, timeouts and security assertions were unchanged.

network.finalState: VM powered off, all NICs disabled, seed detached, local dependency proxy stopped.

limits: The guest was separately created from a verified public Ubuntu OVA on the same physical Windows host; it is not independent customer hardware.
Public toolchain and content-addressed package/image/browser caches were reused; this is not a pristine cold-cache timing result.
The actual GPU Codex coding-to-local-mock-PR workflow was verified separately on Windows/Docker and was not repeated on the 1-vCPU guest.
The final security gate is a continuation on the preserved exact-package application directory after a harness-only invocation defect; the original failure remains immutable.
No live GitHub, customer IdP/SIEM, production data, paid service, external deployment or independent human review was used.
